kultivator.guide.chapter.22.desc: The second road beside founding your own sect: find an NPC sect, pass its entrance test, swear the oath, then rise from Servant Disciple to Sect Master.
kultivator.guide.c22.kenal.title: Learning the Sects
kultivator.guide.c22.kenal.body:
The world has two roads: found a sect of your own, or join one that already stands. They are equal; joining never locks the first road.
A sect enters the Sect Directory once you visit its gate, hear of it in a tea house or inn, or see it on the map. Until then its card only shows "?".
Every sect has a class from its tier: Minor School (tier 1-2), Middle Sect (3-4), Great Sect (5-6), Grand Sect or Holy Land (7-8) and Immortal Sect (9). The higher the class, the harder its test and the richer its pavilion.
Its style comes from its name: Sword, Buddha, Beast, Formation, Element, Alchemy, Body, Blood, Poison or Shadow. The style picks the test, the daily chores, the Heritage Technique and the cut of the robe.
The class shows at the gate: a Middle Sect flies four banners and spirit lanterns, a Great Sect six banners and a faint formation dome, a Grand Sect eight banners, circling cranes and a pillar of light at dusk, an Immortal Sect a crown of golden cloud.
kultivator.guide.c22.lamar.title: Five Doors and the Application
kultivator.guide.c22.lamar.body:
There are five doors. The Gate: take the sect's Test Day (every 10 world days). The Token: a Sect Ascension Token removes the Bone Age limit. The Invitation: a Letter of Invitation from a tournament opens the test without root or age limits. The Servant door: join as a Servant Disciple without the style test. The Guest door: a Foundation cultivator or higher may become a Guest Elder.
Requirements per class: minimum realm and root, Bone Age (the days you have lived in this world; the older you are, the stronger you must be), standing with the sect, Infamy fitting its alignment, and the capital's crime record. The Application screen marks every requirement green or red.
Demonic sects like Infamy and ignore Wanted status; a clean applicant may take the Blood Trial.
Applying makes you a Candidate with a Candidate Token until the next Test Day. A rejection means a 3-day wait and nothing else.
kultivator.guide.c22.ujian.title: The Three-Stage Entrance Test
kultivator.guide.c22.ujian.body:
Stage 1, the Test Stair: climb the sect's mountain stair within 300 seconds. Mountain Pressure rises while you stand still and when a heart-demon illusion appears every quarter of the way; crouch still to meditate and lower it. At 100 you fall to your knees.
Stage 2, the Style Test: one real game per style, for example the Hundred Cuts (Sword), the Corridor of Bronze Men (Buddha, kill nothing), the Stone Maze (Formation), the Five Qi Pillars (Element), One Furnace (Alchemy), Three Cups (Poison) or the Silent Trial (Shadow).
Stage 3, the Heart Test: the Admissions Elder asks three questions. Answers true to the sect's alignment raise its impression of you.
The final score gives the verdict: below 35 rejected, 35-54 Registered Disciple, 55-79 Outer Disciple, 80 or more Outer Disciple with extra merit, and an Exceptional Candidate when your root is HIGH or better or the style test was perfect.
During the test you cannot fly or teleport, and your own disciples stay behind. Dying or leaving the grounds only fails that stage.
kultivator.guide.c22.sumpah.title: The Oath Ceremony
kultivator.guide.c22.sumpah.body:
At the main hall's oath altar (a demonic sect: the blood altar) you kneel, raise three sticks of incense, hear three rules read aloud, then answer [I swear] or [I am not ready].
Swearing gives a Member Badge bound to you, the cosmetic sect robe and provisions by class. The sect's disciples line up to salute you.
[I am not ready] cancels without penalty; you stay a Candidate until your candidacy ends.
kultivator.guide.c22.shifu.title: Shifu: An Elder Chooses a Disciple
kultivator.guide.c22.shifu.body:
An Exceptional Candidate is contested by two or three elders. Each has a style, a temperament and an office of their own; pick one as your Shifu.
The master bond grows through chores, missions and lessons. Your Shifu defends you at the Hall of Law, teaches techniques and comes when you are attacked on sect grounds.
A disciple who surpasses the Shifu's realm makes the old master laugh with pride.
kultivator.guide.c22.tugas.title: Daily Chores
kultivator.guide.c22.tugas.body:
Servant and Registered Disciples must do one chore a day; other ranks may choose. A chore gives 5-15 merit, at most 3 a day.
For example Carrying Water from the well to the vats, Sweeping the Court, Tending the herb garden, Fanning the Furnace, Copying Scriptures, Feeding the Beasts, Morning Drill and Night Watch. The sect's style gives a bonus to its own chore.
Personal merit is the same Contribution Points as everywhere else: 1 merit is worth 2 NB, but merit can never be exchanged for spirit stones or the other way round.
kultivator.guide.c22.paviliun.title: The Merit Pavilion
kultivator.guide.c22.paviliun.body:
The Merit Pavilion sells techniques, the Sect Heritage Technique, pills, treasures, materials, dwellings and secret realm quotas for merit. Its prices are the same prices as anywhere in the world; high ranks get a discount and goods of the sect's Dao are 20% cheaper.
Technique grade is capped by the sect's class and your rank: a Minor School up to HUANG, an Immortal Sect up to ABADI.
The Sect Heritage Technique is bound by the rules: leaking it without a Blessing is an offence.
kultivator.guide.c22.misi.title: The Sect Mission Board
kultivator.guide.c22.misi.body:
The Mission Board is drawn every world day: 4 + class missions from rank E up to the class's highest rank, paid in merit.
Besides hunts, escorts, herbs and lairs there are sect missions: harvesting the herb garden, carrying goods to an allied sect, pill orders for the pavilion, spying on an enemy sect, and group missions with other members.
A failed or expired mission gives no merit and adds a little to your offence record.
kultivator.guide.c22.kediaman.title: Dwelling Caves
kultivator.guide.c22.kediaman.body:
Servant to Outer Disciples sleep in a Dormitory Cell. Inner Disciples may rent a Small Cave, Core Disciples a Vein Cave, the Heir and Elders a Private Peak; a sect with a sky palace rents out Cloud Pavilions.
Rent is paid in merit every 7 days. A cave speeds up cultivation and becomes the target of the Return Talisman. Caves are few; players and sect figures compete for them.
The Spirit Pool in the meditation cave gives 30-minute sessions with a meditation bonus.
kultivator.guide.c22.pangkat_dalam.title: Rising to Inner Disciple
kultivator.guide.c22.pangkat_dalam.body:
The Rank Tree: Servant, Registered, Outer, Inner, Core, then it branches to Heir or to Elder and Vice Master, and both lead to Sect Master. The Guest Elder is a side path.
Outer Disciple needs Qi Refining and 60 merit; Inner Disciple needs Foundation, the Inner Disciple Test and 300 merit; Core Disciple needs Golden Core, a top three place in the Disciple Tournament or one rank A mission, and 1200 merit. Costs are multiplied by the sect's class factor.
A promotion is requested from the Rank Tree screen and sealed in a short ceremony in the hall. Core seats are limited; a seat holder may be challenged once every 7 days.
kultivator.guide.c22.turnamen.title: The Disciple Tournament
kultivator.guide.c22.turnamen.body:
Every 15 world days, at noon, the sect holds the Disciple Tournament on the training ground's lei tai: a bracket of eight from Outer to Core members and the sect's own disciples.
Every round is a Sword Duel that stops at 10% health; nobody dies. The champion earns 300 merit, a 15-day title and a claim on a secret realm quota.
Missing it carries no penalty.
kultivator.guide.c22.perang.title: The War Call
kultivator.guide.c22.perang.body:
When your sect goes to war with another NPC sect, every member receives the War Call for 10 world days. Inner Disciples and above must join at least one mission within 3 days.
War missions: Defend the Gate (three waves of enemy squads at your own gate), Raid the Outpost, the Champion Duel, Rescue the Captives and Escort the Supplies. The war score decides the winner.
Buildings are never damaged by sect wars, and named figures who lose are only wounded.
kultivator.guide.c22.kuota.title: Secret Realm Quotas
kultivator.guide.c22.kuota.body:
Once a month the sect hands out secret realm keys by its class: Blood Fire Tokens, Heavenvoid Maps, Inheritance Crystals and Tomb Sigils.
The Heir gets one by right, then the month's top three in merit and the last tournament champion; the rest are sold at the pavilion.
Hand in your spoils within 3 days of returning for merit and standing; not handing them in carries no penalty.
kultivator.guide.c22.inti.title: Core Disciple
kultivator.guide.c22.inti.body:
A Core Disciple unlocks techniques up to grade DI, a Vein Cave, missions up to rank A and the right to found a Branch.
From here the road forks: the Disciple Path leads to Heir through the Heir Selection, the Elder Path leads to Elder through the Elder Test and then Vice Master.
The sect's rules still apply: the offence record runs 0-100 and fades 1 point every 2 days. At 10 a reprimand, 20 a fine, 35 confinement in the Cave of Reflection, 50 demotion, 60 expulsion.
kultivator.guide.c22.jalan_dua.title: Both Roads at Once
kultivator.guide.c22.jalan_dua.body:
Owning a sect hall of your own does not stop you from joining. A Core Disciple or higher may make the hall a Branch of the NPC sect (sharing its allies and enemies), or instead become a Guest Elder without office.
There are three ways out of a sect. Taking Leave: an honourable exit, with a Letter of Blessing when your bond is good. Expulsion: by the Hall of Law, with a wait before you may apply again. Desertion: fleeing a punishment or betraying the sect; sect hunters will track you and the Heritage Technique may be wiped if you are caught.
kultivator.guide.c22.ketua.title: The Robe and the Bowl
kultivator.guide.c22.ketua.body:
Sect Master is reached from the Disciple Path or the Elder Path through the "Robe and Bowl" succession: the elders' support, a final trial, then the old master hands over the robe and the bowl.
A Sect Master leads wars, keeps the treasury, names the Heir, and may merge the NPC sect with a hall of their own or absorb it.
A sect's class rises and falls over time: donations, war victories and tournaments add to its strength; defeat after defeat makes it decline.
kultivator.gabung.setelan.jubah_di_atas_: The member robe is drawn over chest armour. Off: the robe is hidden while chest armour is worn.
kultivator.gabung.setelan.visual_kelas.t: Extra banners, spirit lanterns, a formation dome, cranes, a dusk pillar of light and a cloud crown at the gates of the NPC sects you know, by class. Minimal: still banners only.
kultivator.gabung.setelan.tangga_ilusi.t: Steps of light, mist and the heart demon's face during the Test Stair, and the style test effects. The step count follows the effect quality (120, 400, 1000).
kultivator.gabung.setelan.nametag_pangka: A small "[Inner]" line in the rank's trim colour above sect members' names within 16 blocks.
